flags.reason: The guide gives no avoidWhen guidance; left empty rather than guessed.

misreads-source: alwaysPresent=false implies the title can be left off, but the guide says "title and subtitle fall back to the words Title and Subtitle". The evidence says "there is no way to hide either", and its Limits say not to imply the title can be hidden.

misreads-source: alwaysPresent=false implies the subtitle can be absent, but per the guide it falls back to the word "Subtitle" when left out. The evidence says it cannot be hidden, and its Limits forbid implying it can.

misreads-source: The why gives the Do caption ("disableTruncation shows all of it, and the card grows") rather than the reason against the Don't. The guide's reason is "The title runs past both edges of the card." The other doDont items use the Don't caption as the why.

These gaps and the guide sentences they rest on were checked on 0.1.78-c7d3348. The installed build, dbe0e02, changed PdpCcCard for #361 (divider, icon size, empty picture box, two-line title), and the guide’s copy waits for #361’s own publish (evidence, 28 October). Re-extract after #361 is published. Added by Claude Code in Penny run run_19b90d38, for Marcin to confirm.

props.name: imageSource
props.description: The picture is shown with cover fit, its corners from image/radius (8 px; the Radius mode changes them), and hidden from screen readers. Declared: Image source for the default media slot. Accepts a URL string or any RN `ImageSourcePropType`. Ignored when `media` is provided.

props.name: imageWidth
props.description: Default media image width. Defaults to the Figma spec (`100`). Default 100, from the component source.

props.name: imageHeight
props.description: Default media image height. Defaults to the Figma spec (`60`). Default 60, from the component source.

props.name: media
props.description: Full override for the media slot (top of the card). Takes precedence over `imageSource`. `modes` cascade into it automatically.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline title (26px black). Omit to keep the sample `"Title"`. Pass `''` or `null` to hide the line.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Subtitle rendered below the title (14px medium). Omit to keep the sample `"Subtitle"`. Pass `''` or `null` to hide the line.

props.name: numberOfLines
props.description: Number of lines to limit the title to. The `Title` component defaults to `1` when this is unset, so the headline is a single line with an ellipsis by default. Pass a larger value (e.g. `2`) to allow the title to wrap onto that many lines before truncating, or set {@link disableTruncation} to remove the clamp entirely. The subtitle is never line-clamped.

props.name: disableTruncation
props.description: When `true`, disables truncation for both the title and subtitle: the trailing ellipsis (`…`) is never shown and the `numberOfLines` clamp is ignored. The text wraps onto as many lines as it needs inside the card.

props.name: singleLine
props.description: When `true`, forces both the title and subtitle onto a single line with no wrapping (implies {@link disableTruncation}). The line is clipped at the card edges rather than running past them.

props.name: metrics
props.description: One equal-width column per entry, each announced as “title, value, caption”. An empty list removes the row; there is no maximum. Declared: The metric columns rendered in the stats row. Vertical dividers are inserted automatically between adjacent metrics. Defaults to two sample metrics (with leading icons) matching the Figma default.

props.name: buttonLabel
props.description: CTA button label. Defaults to `"button"`. Default "button", from the component source.

props.name: buttonIcon
props.description: Registry icon name for the button's leading glyph. Defaults to `'ic_add_circle'`. Pass `null` to hide the leading icon. Default "ic_add_circle", from the component source.

props.name: onButtonPress
props.description: CTA press handler.

props.name: button
props.description: Replaces the default Button; the node gets AppearanceBrand Secondary, Emphasis Medium and Button / Size S, with the card's own modes on top. Declared: Full override for the CTA. Takes precedence over `buttonLabel`.

props.name: showButton
props.description: false removes the button and 44 px of the card's height. Declared: Toggles the CTA button. Defaults to `true`. Default true, from the component source.

props.name: onPress
props.description: The whole card becomes one button, named by accessibilityLabel, else title, and dims to 0.92 opacity while pressed. With the default button still showing, that nests a button in a button. The card has no disabled prop. Declared: Press handler for the whole card. When set, the card becomes pressable.

props.name: width
props.description: Card width. Defaults to the Figma spec (`344`). Pass `'100%'` to fill the parent. Default 344, from the component source.

props.name: modes
props.description: No mode changes the card's own white panel, padding or gap; modes reach the picture, title, metrics and button. Declared: Modes object for design-token resolution. Cascaded to all children.

props.name: style
props.description: Style overrides for the card container.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Accessibility label for the card.

modes.name: AppearanceBrand
modes.description: On the card it changes the button (Primary gold, Neutral grey, Tertiary blue) and the metric icons; left unset, the button and the icons are Secondary purple. Declared: A token collection PdpCcCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

modes.name: AppearanceSystem
modes.description: No effect on its own; with Semantic Intent System, warning and negative turn the button and icons orange and red. Declared: A token collection PdpCcCard reads (the package's FIGMA_COMPONENT_MODES). When modes leave it unset, the resolver uses the collection's default mode.

gaps.text: No divider line shows between metrics on the web, where Figma draws one 46 px tall (#361).
Without imageSource an empty picture box keeps its space above the title; the package ships no default picture (#361).
The button's plus icon is 18 px where Figma's is 16 (#361).
The card is 316 px tall where Figma's is 310, because its text lines are taller (#361).
On the web, with numberOfLines 2 the title's ellipsis renders partly cut.
